card.name: Words just before uneven, varied things
card.fires_on: Small words or adjectives right before a word describing something non-uniform, such as mixed, diverse, rough, correlated or varied. Mostly in scientific or descriptive web text.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like decentralized, dispersed, heterogeneous and fragmented, which describe things that are spread out or not uniform.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into descriptions of things that are mixed, uneven or spread out.
